purpose: Debate civic duty; teach 義務/差別/裁判所/総理/国務大臣/局長/設立/副

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国民の義務って、税金以外に何がありますか？
lines.en: Besides taxes, what duties do citizens have?
lines.style: inquisitive student opening a debate, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教育や勤労も、憲法上の義務とされます。
lines.en: Education and labor are constitutional duties too.
lines.style: teacher citing the constitution, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 差別をしないことも、社会の責任ですよね。
lines.en: Not discriminating is a social responsibility too.
lines.style: teen adding a moral dimension, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、裁判所もそれを重視しています。
lines.en: Yes, the courts emphasize that too.
lines.style: teacher reinforcing with authority, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 総理のリーダーシップも問われますね。
lines.en: The prime minister’s leadership is tested too.
lines.style: student widening to leadership, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国務大臣たちの連携も欠かせません。
lines.en: Coordination among ministers is essential too.
lines.style: teacher noting collective governance, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 各省の局長が現場を動かすんですね。
lines.en: Each ministry’s bureau director runs the front line.
lines.style: teen grasping the operational layer, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい部署の設立も、副大臣が主導するとか。
lines.en: A deputy minister reportedly leads founding the new section.
lines.style: student tying threads together, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
